# VoteRangeDialog nextStep Skips Form Validation
VoteRangeDialog.vue's nextStep set active=1 directly without validating required form fields, allowing navigation past incomplete forms.

## Root Cause
- `VoteRangeDialog.vue` `nextStep` directly set `active=1` without calling `this.$refs['form'].validate()`
- Required fields such as `policymaker` were not validated before advancing

## Fix
- In `nextStep`, validate the form first and only proceed after validation passes
- Affected files: `ownerDecision/components/VoteRangeDialog.vue` and `decisionCommon/components/VoteRangeDialog.vue`

# Permission-Based Button Hiding Is Expected
Normal users lacking a permission char see no button; this is intended behavior, not a code defect, so no fix is needed.

## Root Cause
- Button visibility depends on permission characters
- Admin `*:*:*` bypasses all checks; normal users without the matching char (e.g. `deposit:depositnotice:rev`) are hidden by both `checkPermission` and `v-hasPermi`
- This is expected behavior, not a bug

## Affected Files
- `directives/permission/hasPermi.js`, `hasRole.js`, `index.js`
- `main.js`, `store/modules/user.js`, `utils/permission.js`
- `permission/index.js`, `views/repairFunds/deposit/depositnotice/detail.vue`

# Route Name Mismatch and Empty route.name Cause White Screen
Hardcoded route names failed to match refactored menus and `$route.name.split('/')` threw on unnamed routes, blanking the voting detail page.

## Root Cause
- Code hardcoded route name `OwnerDecision/maintain/:tableid`, not matching refactored menu `estate/maintainDecision/detail`
- `maintainDecision/detail.vue` and `ownerDecision/detail.vue` called `$route.name.split('/')` which threw when route had no `name`, causing white screen

## Fix
- Added `pushMaintainDecisionDetail()` in `decisionCommon/config.js` to auto-match routes and stay compatible with legacy names
- Added `parseMaintainVoteSession()` to safely read prefilled data
